conflicts.fact: Widths of 20 m or more versus above 20 m
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says widths of 20 m or more do not give a plot, while Lesson 3 says widths above 20 m are impossible. At 20 m the length is 0, so both mean no plot, which makes this a wording difference only.
